primary_diagnosis_treated: Stage 2 hypertension and dyslipidaemia (metabolic syndrome components)

medications.dose: 2.5 mg orally once daily; increase to 5 mg after 2 weeks, then titrate up to 10 mg as needed to reach BP <140/90 mmHg
medications.duration: Lifelong — review annually and after each dose change
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 recommends an ACE‑I as first‑line therapy for adults <55 y who are not Afro‑Caribbean

medications.dose: 20 mg orally once daily in the evening; if LDL‑C reduction <40 % after 3 months, increase to 40 mg daily
medications.duration: Lifelong — lipid profile at 3 months then annually
medications.purpose: Reduce LDL‑C and overall cardiovascular risk
medications.nice_justification: NICE CG181/PH46 advises high‑intensity statin for LDL‑C >100 mg/dL with additional risk factors (obesity, hypertension, pre‑diabetes)

medications.dose: 500 mg orally once daily with evening meal; increase by 500 mg weekly to 1 g twice daily as tolerated (max 2 g/day)
medications.purpose: Improve glycaemic control in high‑risk prediabetes
medications.nice_justification: NICE PH38 recommends metformin for high‑risk prediabetes (BMI ≥35 kg/m² or age <60 y with HbA1c 6.0‑6.4 % and cardiovascular risk factors)

assumptions_warnings: eGFR not provided – assumed ≥60 mL/min/1.73 m² for safe ACE‑I and metformin initiation; renal function must be checked before starting.
Baseline liver function tests not available – required before initiating atorvastatin.
Pregnancy status unknown – patient must confirm non‑pregnancy before ACE‑I and statin prescription.
Allergy history not documented – verify no ACE‑I, statin, or metformin hypersensitivity.
QRISK score not calculated – LDL‑C >200 mg/dL with risk factors justifies statin per NICE, but formal QRISK should be performed when data available.
treatment_summary: Start ramipril to achieve BP control, initiate high‑intensity atorvastatin for marked LDL‑C elevation, and consider metformin for high‑risk prediabetes, pending renal and hepatic safety checks. Provide lifestyle advice (weight loss, DASH/Mediterranean diet, 150 min/week exercise, salt <6 g/day, smoking cessation) and arrange follow‑up labs and BP monitoring per NICE NG136 and CG181/PH46.
